description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'ExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter' responsible for converting exceptions, particularly 'DittoRuntimeException's, into acknowledgements within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for handling exceptions, generating payloads, and extracting relevant information for acknowledgement messages.

classes.name: ExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter
classes.description: An abstract class that provides logic for converting various exceptions into acknowledgements, differentiating handling for DittoRuntimeException and other exceptions.

methods.name: convertException
methods.description: Converts an exception into an acknowledgement, calling specific methods based on whether it is a DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: convertDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a DittoRuntimeException into an acknowledgement, using its status code and JSON payload.

methods.name: convertGenericException
methods.description: Converts a non-DittoRuntimeException into an acknowledgement with a generated payload.

methods.name: getStatusCodeForGenericException
methods.description: Abstract method meant to be implemented by subclasses to specify HTTP status codes for generic exceptions.
